title: A Deadly Aid Delivery and Growing Threat of Famine in Gaza

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Late last week,
sentences.zh: 上周晚些时候，

sentences.en: an effort to get food into northern Gaza turned deadly as thousands of desperate Gazans descended on aid trucks and Israeli troops tasked with guarding those trucks opened fire.
sentences.zh: 一场向加沙北部运送食品的行动演变成了一场致命悲剧，数千名绝望的加沙人涌向援助卡车，负责守卫这些卡车的以色列军队开火了。

sentences.en: But exactly how people died and who was responsible remains contested.
sentences.zh: 但人们究竟是如何死亡的，以及谁该负责，目前仍有争议。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Hiba Yazbek on what we know about what happened and what it tells us about hunger in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事希巴·亚兹贝克将带我们了解已知的情况，以及这反映了加沙怎样的饥荒现状。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月5日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Hiba, we are now in the fifth month of Israel's war against Hamas in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 那么，希巴，以色列在加沙针对哈马斯的战争现在已经进入第五个月了。

sentences.en: And for weeks, we've been hearing about negotiations over a ceasefire and a hostage exchange.
sentences.zh: 几周以来，我们一直听到关于停火和人质交换的谈判消息。

sentences.en: And then, late last week, there was a disaster surrounding an aid convoy that was brought into Gaza.
sentences.zh: 然后，在上周晚些时候，发生了一起涉及运往加沙的援助车队的灾难。

sentences.en: You've been reporting on what happened.
sentences.zh: 你一直在报道这件事。

sentences.en: Tell us about it.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲吧。

sentences.en: So, last Thursday, there was a deadly disaster involving civilians, possibly the deadliest disaster since the war started nearly five months ago,
sentences.zh: 上周四发生了一起涉及平民的致命灾难，这可能是自近五个月前战争开始以来最致命的灾难，

sentences.en: in which 118 Palestinians were killed and more than 760 were wounded in Gaza City.
sentences.zh: 造成加沙城118名巴勒斯坦人死亡，760多人受伤。

sentences.en: But there are conflicting reports on how they died and what exactly happened.
sentences.zh: 但关于他们是如何死亡以及究竟发生了什么，存在相互矛盾的报道。

sentences.en: The Israeli military has one account of what happened, and the Gaza Health Ministry and witnesses have another account.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方对所发生的事情有一种说法，而加沙卫生部和目击者则有另一种说法。

sentences.en: So, my colleagues and I started digging into the details.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和我的同事们开始深入挖掘细节。

sentences.en: We started calling people, piecing together a picture of what had actually happened there.
sentences.zh: 我们开始联系相关人员，拼凑出当时实际发生情况的画面。

sentences.en: And what did you find when you guys started really looking into this?
sentences.zh: 当你们真正开始调查时，发现了什么？

sentences.en: So, first, let me just give you the context of what happened.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我先为你介绍一下事件的背景。

sentences.en: This happened in northern Gaza, the place that has been at war the longeSt.
sentences.zh: 这件事发生在加沙北部，那是战争持续时间最长的地方。

sentences.en: That's where Israeli ground forces began their invasion of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 以色列地面部队就是从那里开始入侵加沙地带的。

sentences.en: Many people have left the north, but we do know that some 300,000 people are still there.
sentences.zh: 许多人已经离开了北部，但我们知道仍有约30万人留在那里。

sentences.en: And the people who have remained there are really living through very desperate conditions.
sentences.zh: 留在那里的民众确实生活在极其绝望的境地中。

sentences.en: Very little aid has come in to the north of Gaza since the war started, and especially in recent weeks.
sentences.zh: 自战争开始以来，尤其是最近几周，进入加沙北部的援助物资微乎其微。

sentences.en: And food is barely available for the people who have remained there.
sentences.zh: 留在那里的民众几乎没有食物可吃。

sentences.en: And the UN has been warning of a famine that is looming over the territory.
sentences.zh: 联合国一直警告称，该地区正面临饥荒的威胁。

sentences.en: And Hiba, why is there so little aid getting into northern Gaza in particular?
sentences.zh: 希巴，为什么进入加沙北部的援助物资尤其少？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, there's less aid getting into the Gaza Strip in general, not just the north.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，进入整个加沙地带的援助物资总体上都在减少，不仅仅是北部。

sentences.en: There's multiple reasons as to why that is.
sentences.zh: 造成这种情况的原因有很多。

sentences.en: But one of the main reasons is that Israel itself has been very slow to approve permits and often denies permits for aid trucks and aid convoys to come in,
sentences.zh: 但主要原因之一是以色列自身在批准许可证方面非常缓慢，并且经常拒绝援助卡车和车队进入，

sentences.en: specifically to the north.
sentences.zh: 特别是针对北部地区。

sentences.en: Because Israel says that they don't want the aid to end up in the hands of Hamas, that they don't want them to get a hold of the packages.
sentences.zh: 因为以色列称他们不希望援助物资落入哈马斯手中，不希望他们拿到这些包裹。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And when Israel does approve the permits and the aid trucks start their journeys,
sentences.zh: 当以色列批准许可证，援助卡车开始行程时，

sentences.en: there's multiple hurdles that they have to go through in order to actually deliver it to the people.
sentences.zh: 它们必须克服多重障碍才能真正将物资送到民众手中。

sentences.en: Some of these hurdles include the widespread destruction in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 其中一些障碍包括加沙广泛的破坏。

sentences.en: There's vast damage across the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 整个加沙地带遭受了巨大的破坏。

sentences.en: Roads have been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 道路被毁。

sentences.en: There's rubble everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是瓦砾。

sentences.en: And it's very difficult for the trucks to actually move through that rubble and through those roads.
sentences.zh: 卡车很难穿过那些瓦砾和道路。

sentences.en: And then these aid convoys have to go through multiple Israeli checkpoints on the way.
sentences.zh: 而且这些援助车队在途中必须经过多个以色列检查站。

sentences.en: And there's often significant delays at these checkpoints by Israeli soldiers who are inspecting the aid.
sentences.zh: 在这些检查站，以色列士兵检查援助物资时经常会造成严重的延误。

sentences.en: This makes it hard for the trucks to make it from where they enter in the south all the way to the north in the specific safety window that they're given.
sentences.zh: 这使得卡车很难在规定的安全窗口内从南部的入口一路到达北部。

sentences.en: And sometimes they make it halfway through and they turn around because they got delayed so much that they can't keep going.
sentences.zh: 有时它们走到一半就不得不折返，因为延误太严重，无法继续前行。

sentences.en: But there's a particular problem with the north where fighting has been going on the longeSt.
sentences.zh: 但北部有一个特殊的问题，那就是战斗持续时间最长。

sentences.en: The civil order is now breaking down, essentially.
sentences.zh: 社会秩序基本上正在崩溃。

sentences.en: We know that frequent Israeli strikes on Palestinian policemen meant that there's really no one to run security for official groups and for aid convoys,
sentences.zh: 我们知道，以色列频繁袭击巴勒斯坦警察，意味着实际上没有人能为官方组织和援助车队提供安全保障，

sentences.en: leaving them vulnerable to attacks by local gangs who are trying to steal the aid and sell it or profit off of it.
sentences.zh: 使他们容易受到当地帮派的攻击，这些帮派试图窃取援助物资并将其出售或从中获利。

sentences.en: And also hungry and desperate civilians who are trying to grab the aid and take as much as they can,
sentences.zh: 还有饥饿绝望的平民试图抢夺援助物资，尽可能多地拿走，

sentences.en: which, you know, means that they end up stealing some of it, looting some of it while it's still on the way.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们最终会在物资运输途中窃取或抢劫其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's like lawlessness and effectively social order breakdown.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是无法无天，实际上是社会秩序的崩溃。

sentences.en: I mean, this is kind of the downstream effects of extended war in a particular place, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种长期战争在特定地区产生的连锁反应，对吧？

sentences.en: There's a power vacuum and that situation, you know, can be very difficult for an organization like the United Nations to be able to operate safely.
sentences.zh: 出现了权力真空，这种情况对于联合国这样的组织来说，要安全开展工作是非常困难的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the few aid trucks that do come in have had to either suspend their aid deliveries into the north or have not been able to deliver aid there.
sentences.zh: 而仅有的几辆进入的援助卡车，要么不得不暂停向北部运送援助，要么根本无法在那里运送物资。

sentences.en: The last time Anurwa, the UN agency in charge of Palestinian refugees, tried to bring trucks to the north was nearly a month ago.
sentences.zh: 负责巴勒斯坦难民事务的联合国机构近东救济工程处上一次尝试向北部运送卡车是在近一个月前。

sentences.en: But they said that one of their convoys came under fire.
sentences.zh: 但他们表示，他们的一个车队遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: And another major aid provider, the World Food Programme, said that they haven't delivered aid there in over three weeks.
sentences.zh: 另一个主要的援助提供者，世界粮食计划署，表示他们已经超过三周没有在那里运送援助了。

sentences.en: And they cited all of the reasons we talked about for this suspension.
sentences.zh: 他们列举了我们刚才讨论的所有导致暂停的原因。

sentences.en: So while aid hasn't been coming into the north, people have been growing more desperate and hungry.
sentences.zh: 因此，当援助物资无法进入北部时，人们变得越来越绝望和饥饿。

sentences.en: And the situation there has been getting worse, which has been raising international alarm.
sentences.zh: 那里的局势一直在恶化，这引起了国际社会的警觉。

sentences.en: And there's been increased calls on Israel to let aid go through to the north and to alleviate the suffering of the residents there.
sentences.zh: 要求以色列允许援助物资进入北部并减轻当地居民苦难的呼声也越来越高。

sentences.en: So Israel partnered with these local Palestinian businessmen in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 于是，以色列与加沙当地的巴勒斯坦商人进行了合作，

sentences.en: and they promised to secure the aid convoys that the businessmen would supply and that would make their way into the north.
sentences.zh: 他们承诺保护这些商人供应并运往北部的援助车队。

sentences.en: And they successfully did this three times last week.
sentences.zh: 上周他们成功地完成了三次这样的行动。

sentences.en: So people started being very hopeful that more would come.
sentences.zh: 所以人们开始非常希望会有更多的物资到来。

sentences.en: And ahead of the fourth delivery, they started to gather at this distribution point right outside of Gaza City in the north.
sentences.zh: 在第四次运送之前，人们开始聚集在北部加沙城外的一个分发点。

sentences.en: And that brings us to Thursday's incident.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了周四发生的事件。

sentences.en: So last Thursday, around 4.45 a.m., around 38 aid trucks reached this distribution point.
sentences.zh: 上周四凌晨4点45分左右，约38辆援助卡车到达了这个分发点。

sentences.en: And they start getting closer to the crowds of people who had camped there overnight, waiting for this aid to come.
sentences.zh: 它们开始靠近那些通宵露宿在那里等待援助的人群。

sentences.en: And when the people see the trucks coming, they're very desperate.
sentences.zh: 当人们看到卡车过来时，他们非常绝望。

sentences.en: They surround them.
sentences.zh: 他们包围了卡车。

sentences.en: They get on top of them.
sentences.zh: 他们爬上了车顶。

sentences.en: And then at some point, Israeli soldiers start firing shots.
sentences.zh: 然后在某个时刻，以色列士兵开始开火。

sentences.en: And then it turned violent very faSt.
sentences.zh: 随后局势迅速变得暴力。

sentences.en: And it ended with 118 Palestinians dead and 760 injured.
sentences.zh: 最终导致118名巴勒斯坦人死亡，760人受伤。

sentences.en: And this is where the accounts diverge.
sentences.zh: 这就是双方说法出现分歧的地方。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's start with the Israeli account.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们先从以色列方面的说法开始。

sentences.en: What do they say happened?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So the Israeli military said that it was trying to secure the convoy and it had tanks nearby to make sure that the convoy reached the area.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方表示，他们当时正在努力保护车队，附近有坦克以确保车队到达该区域。

sentences.en: And it did acknowledge that its troops had opened fire at the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他们确实承认部队向人群开了火。

sentences.en: But they said that they opened fire when a violent crowd or a violent mob approached their troops and endangered their lives.
sentences.zh: 但他们称，当暴力人群或暴徒接近他们的部队并危及他们的生命时，他们才开了火。

sentences.en: And they said the shots that were fired weren't really the reason why so many people died.
sentences.zh: 他们还说，开火并不是导致那么多人死亡的真正原因。

sentences.en: But the reason that so many people died was because in the chaos of all of it, they trampled each other.
sentences.zh: 导致那么多人死亡的原因是，在混乱中，人们发生了踩踏。

sentences.en: And many had died from suffocation or trampling and also that the trucks had run over some of the people who were trying to run away.
sentences.zh: 许多人死于窒息或踩踏，而且卡车也碾压了一些试图逃跑的人。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So the Israelis don't deny actually shooting, but they say it was more about controlling the crowd kind of as warning shots type thing.
sentences.zh: 所以以色列人并不否认开枪，但他们说这更多是为了控制人群，类似于警告射击。

sentences.en: And that this was not the way people actually died.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是人们实际死亡的方式。

sentences.en: They say the way people actually died was suffocation or being crushed by the aid trucks themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们说人们实际死亡的原因是窒息，或者是被援助卡车本身碾压。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what did the Gazan health authorities say?
sentences.zh: 那么加沙卫生部门是怎么说的？

sentences.en: So the Gazan health authorities have actually been calling this the flower massacre or the massacre of the hungry stomachs.
sentences.zh: 加沙卫生部门实际上将此称为“面粉大屠杀”或“饥饿胃部大屠杀”。

sentences.en: Because what they're saying is that Israeli forces fired at a crowd of hungry and desperate people who are waiting for aid.
sentences.zh: 因为他们说的是，以色列军队向等待援助的饥饿绝望的人群开了火。

sentences.en: And witnesses and Palestinians who were there have said that although some people were trampled and possibly run over by the trucks,
sentences.zh: 在场的目击者和巴勒斯坦人表示，虽然有些人确实被踩踏，甚至可能被卡车碾压，

sentences.en: that was not the main reason for the high death toll.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是造成高死亡人数的主要原因。

sentences.en: Most of the people who were injured or killed were injured and killed by Israeli fire.
sentences.zh: 大多数受伤或死亡的人都是被以色列的火力所伤或杀害的。

sentences.en: So the Gazan health authorities are essentially saying this was a massacre by Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以加沙卫生部门基本上是在说，这是一场由以色列制造的大屠杀。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Do we know, Hiba, what actually did happen?
sentences.zh: 希巴，我们知道到底发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: What have you guys found in your reporting?
sentences.zh: 你们在报道中发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the Israeli military released drone footage that it claimed showed a mass stampede in which Gazans are trampled.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方发布了无人机画面，声称显示了加沙人被踩踏的大规模踩踏事件。

sentences.en: But that video only added to the confusion of the sequence of events.
sentences.zh: 但那段视频只会让事件发生的顺序更加混乱。

sentences.en: And the quality and the lengths of the clips made it more difficult to confirm these claiMs.
sentences.zh: 而且剪辑的质量和长度使得确认这些说法变得更加困难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was just grainy.
sentences.zh: 画面很模糊。

sentences.en: There was no sound.
sentences.zh: 没有声音。

sentences.en: You saw people scramble and run, but you didn't understand why.
sentences.zh: 你看到人们在挣扎和奔跑，但你不明白为什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The drone footage was heavily edited and it left out key moments, but it did show hundreds of people circling around the trucks and hoping to catch a bag of flour.
sentences.zh: 无人机画面经过了大量剪辑，遗漏了关键时刻，但它确实显示了数百人围着卡车，希望能抢到一袋面粉。

sentences.en: And then suddenly we see people start to panic and run in multiple directions.
sentences.zh: 然后突然我们看到人们开始恐慌并向四面八方奔跑。

sentences.en: And then they released another clip in which we see two Israeli tanks that are positioned about a quarter mile down the road.
sentences.zh: 接着他们发布了另一段剪辑，其中我们看到两辆以色列坦克停在路边约四分之一英里处。

sentences.en: And then we see about a dozen bodies lying around them.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到大约十几具尸体躺在它们周围。

sentences.en: And we see people crawling and ducking for cover.
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们在爬行和躲避掩护。

sentences.en: But we did have another video that was released by Al Jazeera.
sentences.zh: 但我们还有另一段由半岛电视台发布的视频。

sentences.en: And it showed a crowd near the eight convoy.
sentences.zh: 它显示了援助车队附近的人群。

sentences.en: And it also captured the sound of gunfire and showed multiple tracer rounds, which is a special type of ammunition that helps troops fine tune their targeting when it's dark.
sentences.zh: 它还捕捉到了枪声，并显示了多枚曳光弹，这是一种特殊的弹药，可以帮助部队在黑暗中微调目标。

sentences.en: And the tracer rounds originated from the direction of a nearby Israeli military base.
sentences.zh: 而曳光弹是从附近一个以色列军事基地的方向射出的。

sentences.en: So although that did not conclude that the shots came from the direction of the Israeli military, it did add another layer of evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管这并不能断定枪声就是来自以色列军队的方向，但它确实增加了一层证据。

sentences.en: So, Hib, it sounds like these videos are suggestive but not conclusive.
sentences.zh: 希巴，听起来这些视频具有暗示性，但并非决定性证据。

sentences.en: But what did the people you spoke to on the ground say?
sentences.zh: 那么你在实地采访的人是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The eyewitnesses and survivors and doctors you spoke with?
sentences.zh: 你采访的目击者、幸存者和医生们？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We spoke to witnesses and survivors as well as doctors at the hospitals that have taken in the people who were wounded and killed.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了目击者和幸存者，以及接收伤亡人员的医院医生。

sentences.en: And they said that most of the people had died or were wounded by gunshots.
sentences.zh: 他们说大多数人都是死于或伤于枪击。

sentences.en: And the doctor who runs one of the four main hospitals in the area that took in the casualties told me that out of the 13 people who were killed and the 170 people who were wounded that the hospital took in,
sentences.zh: 该地区接收伤亡人员的四家主要医院之一的院长告诉我，在医院接收的13名死者和170名伤者中，

sentences.en: all of the injuries were of gunshot wounds.
sentences.zh: 所有的伤情都是枪伤。

sentences.en: He said that they didn't see any injuries that coincided with those of a stampede or people being run over by trucks.
sentences.zh: 他说他们没有看到任何与踩踏或被卡车碾压相符的伤情。

sentences.en: And that account echoes the ones that we've heard from witnesses and people who were there who saw people get shot and fall to the ground next to them.
sentences.zh: 这一说法与我们从目击者和在场人员那里听到的说法相呼应，他们看到人们在身边中枪倒地。

sentences.en: But in the chaos of everything, people were not checking who's dead and who's wounded.
sentences.zh: 但在混乱中，人们并没有去检查谁死了，谁受伤了。

sentences.en: They were just taking the flower and they were running for their lives.
sentences.zh: 他们只是拿着面粉，为了活命而奔跑。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175周年。

sentences.en: So Hiba, I want to talk about what people are doing to survive in northern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 希巴，我想谈谈人们在加沙北部是如何生存的。

sentences.en: But before we get to that, what is the big picture on the state of hunger in Gaza?
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，加沙饥荒状况的总体情况如何？

sentences.en: Hunger has reached unprecedented levels in Gaza and specifically in northern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 加沙，特别是加沙北部的饥饿程度已达到前所未有的水平。

sentences.en: And we're starting to already see reports of children dying from malnutrition and dehydration.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开始看到儿童死于营养不良和脱水的报道。

sentences.en: And this week, the health ministry said that 15 children have died from malnutrition and dehydration at just one of northern Gaza's hospitals.
sentences.zh: 本周，卫生部表示，仅在加沙北部的一家医院，就有15名儿童死于营养不良和脱水。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: 15 children have actually died?
sentences.zh: 真的有15名儿童死亡吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we also have the UN and aid organizations saying that one in six children in northern Gaza were acutely malnutritioned and that more than 90 percent of children under two are facing severe food poverty.
sentences.zh: 联合国和援助组织也表示，加沙北部六分之一的儿童患有严重营养不良，超过90%的两岁以下儿童面临严重的食物匮乏。

sentences.en: And the UN humanitarian coordinator said that a quarter of all Gazan residents are one step away from famine.
sentences.zh: 联合国人道主义协调员表示，四分之一的加沙居民距离饥荒仅一步之遥。

sentences.en: And how exactly are people surviving, Hiba?
sentences.zh: 希巴，人们到底是如何生存的？

sentences.en: I mean, I mean, you're talking to people in northern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你正在与加沙北部的人们交谈。

sentences.en: What are they saying?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: I've been reporting on hunger for weeks and I've talked to people about what they're doing in order to survive with such little food.
sentences.zh: 过去几周我一直在报道饥荒问题，并与人们交谈，了解他们在食物如此匮乏的情况下是如何生存的。

sentences.en: And I recently talked to one woman whose experience is very typical in northern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 最近我采访了一位女性，她的经历在加沙北部非常典型。

sentences.en: Her name is Ghada Krayim.
sentences.zh: 她叫加达·克拉伊姆（Ghada Krayim）。

sentences.en: She's a 23-year-old woman from the north who stayed in the north and didn't flee.
sentences.zh: 她今年23岁，来自北部，一直留守在北部，没有逃离。

sentences.en: And tell me about Ghada.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲加达的情况吧。

sentences.en: Ghada is one of 10 kids.
sentences.zh: 加达家里有10个孩子。

sentences.en: She has six sisters and three brothers.
sentences.zh: 她有六个姐妹和三个兄弟。

sentences.en: And she's actually Gaza's first female solar power engineer.
sentences.zh: 她其实是加沙第一位女性太阳能工程师。

sentences.en: She's won many awards internationally.
sentences.zh: 她曾在国际上获得过许多奖项。

sentences.en: And she's also the sole provider for her family.
sentences.zh: 她也是家里唯一的经济支柱。

sentences.en: And she's used the money that she won from these grants and competitions to help her family through this war.
sentences.zh: 她用从这些奖金和竞赛中赢得的钱来帮助家人度过这场战争。

sentences.en: And with that money, she actually stockpiled a bunch of food in the beginning of the war, expecting the situation to deteriorate.
sentences.zh: 用这笔钱，她在战争初期囤积了大量食物，因为预料到局势会恶化。

sentences.en: She bought flour and milk and canned food and everything they might need.
sentences.zh: 她买了面粉、牛奶、罐头食品以及他们可能需要的一切。

sentences.en: And they stockpiled it in their home.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些东西囤在家里。

sentences.en: And how is it that they're still in northern Gaza?
sentences.zh: 那他们为什么还留在加沙北部呢？

sentences.en: Well, actually, they tried to stay in their home for as long as they possibly could, until the ground fighting really basically reached their doorstep.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，他们尽可能长时间地待在家里，直到地面战斗基本上打到了家门口。

sentences.en: And at one point, early on during Israel's ground invasion of the north,
sentences.zh: 在以色列对北部进行地面入侵的早期阶段，有一次，

sentences.en: Israeli soldiers came to their building and they forced them out.
sentences.zh: 以色列士兵来到他们的大楼，强迫他们离开。

sentences.en: They asked everyone to leave the building and they detained all of the men and the boys who were later released.
sentences.zh: 他们要求所有人离开大楼，并拘留了所有的男性和男孩，这些人后来被释放了。

sentences.en: And she was forced to leave with nothing.
sentences.zh: 她被迫离开时什么都没带。

sentences.en: They took nothing with them, like many other Gazans.
sentences.zh: 和许多其他加沙人一样，他们什么都没带走。

sentences.en: And they moved.
sentences.zh: 然后他们搬迁了。

sentences.en: They moved 12 times since.
sentences.zh: 此后他们搬了12次家。

sentences.en: One of those times was to the south, where they got there and they realized that it actually wasn't much safer.
sentences.zh: 其中有一次是搬到了南部，但到了那里他们发现其实并没有安全多少。

sentences.en: It wasn't better for them.
sentences.zh: 情况对他们来说并没有好转。

sentences.en: So they realized that they should probably just go back to the north and stay as close as possible to their home in case they're able to go back later.
sentences.zh: 所以他们意识到，或许还是应该回到北部，尽可能靠近自己的家，以防以后能回去。

sentences.en: But that never happened because Israeli forces took up their home as a military base and they were there for two weeks, she said.
sentences.zh: 但那从未发生，因为她说，以色列军队把他们的家当作了军事基地，并在那里驻扎了两周。

sentences.en: After they'd left, two weeks later, she went back to check on her home and it was burned.
sentences.zh: 两周后他们离开，她回去查看自己的家，发现房子已经被烧毁了。

sentences.en: There was nothing left, including the food that she'd stockpiled.
sentences.zh: 什么都没剩下，包括她囤积的食物。

sentences.en: And now she's sheltering with 50 members of her extended family, including children in a two-bedroom apartment in the north.
sentences.zh: 现在，她和50名大家庭成员挤在北部的一间两居室公寓里避难，其中包括孩子。

sentences.en: Fifty people in a two-bedroom apartment.
sentences.zh: 五十个人挤在一间两居室公寓里。

sentences.en: That is extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: So what did they do for food early in the war?
sentences.zh: 那么他们在战争初期是怎么解决吃饭问题的？

sentences.en: Well, she told me that in the beginning of the war, they still were able to find some things to buy and eat, like rice and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她告诉我，战争刚开始时，他们还能找到一些东西买来吃，比如大米和蔬菜。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: She said that by the end of December, basically, when aid to the north became less frequent and things that they were eating had started to run out,
sentences.zh: 她说到了12月底，基本上当运往北部的援助变得越来越少，他们吃的东西也开始耗尽时，

sentences.en: including flour, which became much less available and much more expensive,
sentences.zh: 包括面粉，面粉变得越来越难买，价格也贵得多，

sentences.en: they didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道该怎么办了。

sentences.en: I mean, they had nothing to eat, so they started mixing water with starch to eat.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们没东西吃，所以开始用水和淀粉混合着吃。

sentences.en: They were having one meal a day and the children were constantly hungry.
sentences.zh: 他们每天只吃一顿饭，孩子们总是处于饥饿状态。

sentences.en: So they had to find an alternative.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须找到替代品。

sentences.en: And that alternative was animal food.
sentences.zh: 而那个替代品就是动物饲料。

sentences.en: So she told me that they started grinding up really any animal food that they could find.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，他们开始把能找到的任何动物饲料磨碎。

sentences.en: So rabbit food and bird food and hay and fodder, really anything that they could get their hands on.
sentences.zh: 兔子饲料、鸟食、干草和草料，真的只要能弄到手的都行。

sentences.en: And they would use that to make bread with.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会用这些东西来做面包。

sentences.en: But the bread was very dry and it smelled bad, it tasted bad, and it made their stomachs hurt.
sentences.zh: 但面包非常干，闻起来很难闻，吃起来味道也很差，而且还会让他们胃痛。

sentences.en: But she said that the one that was the worst for her was the bird food.
sentences.zh: 但她说，最让她受不了的是鸟食。

sentences.en: She said that the bird food tasted and smelled as if you were sitting with a bunch of chicken.
sentences.zh: 她说鸟食的味道和气味就像是你和一群鸡待在一起一样。

sentences.en: The smell was very bad and the taste was even worse.
sentences.zh: 气味非常难闻，味道更糟。

sentences.en: But she told me that even though this stuff tasted and smelled bad, they really tried to make it as less awful as possible.
sentences.zh: 但她告诉我，尽管这些东西又难吃又难闻，他们还是尽量让它变得不那么糟糕。

sentences.en: She told me that one of her cousins sheltering with her loved to bake and she made really tasty sweets before the war.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，和她一起避难的一位表亲很喜欢烘焙，战前她做的甜点非常美味。

sentences.en: So basically she tried to make the most out of these ingredients.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，她试图充分利用这些食材。

sentences.en: And she was making desserts using the cornmeal and the rabbit food.
sentences.zh: 她用玉米粉和兔子饲料做甜点。

sentences.en: And she was also making other savory dishes that they liked and they ate frequently before the war.
sentences.zh: 她还做了一些他们喜欢、战前经常吃的咸味菜肴。

sentences.en: She used the animal feed to make maftool, which is the Palestinian version of couscous.
sentences.zh: 她用动物饲料做马夫图尔（maftool），也就是巴勒斯坦版的库斯库斯。

sentences.en: So she was making it with the ground up animal feed.
sentences.zh: 所以她是拿磨碎的动物饲料做的。

sentences.en: Yes, but that was still not enough.
sentences.zh: 是的，但这仍然不够。

sentences.en: At that point, Ghada and her family were only eating one meal a day.
sentences.zh: 那时，加达和她的家人每天只吃一顿饭。

sentences.en: And that was not enough for them or the children in the family.
sentences.zh: 这对他们或家里的孩子来说根本不够。

sentences.en: She told me that her little sister, two-year-old Elin, who's actually the youngest person sheltering with them, was hungry all the time.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她的小妹妹，两岁的埃琳（Elin），也是和他们一起避难的人中最小的一个，一直都在挨饿。

sentences.en: She was going to sleep crying and waking up crying.
sentences.zh: 她总是哭着睡着，又哭着醒来。

sentences.en: And she loved milk, but they ran out of milk more than two months ago.
sentences.zh: 她很喜欢喝牛奶，但他们两个多月前就断奶了。

sentences.en: So what they've been doing is basically giving her expired juice.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在做的事，基本上就是给她喝过期的果汁。

sentences.en: It was actually not even juice.
sentences.zh: 其实那甚至算不上果汁。

sentences.en: It's a concentrated juice that they would mix with water.
sentences.zh: 那是需要兑水喝的浓缩果汁。

sentences.en: And because it was expired, it was making her sick.
sentences.zh: 而且因为它过期了，喝了让她生病。

sentences.en: But that was the only thing that they could give her in place of milk.
sentences.zh: 但那是他们唯一能代替牛奶给她的东西。

sentences.en: And when they were able to, they would give her sugar cane that they would find in the market and lemons as a snack.
sentences.zh: 当他们能弄到的时候，会给她一些在市场上找到的甘蔗和柠檬作为零食。

sentences.en: And sometimes when those weren't even available, they would just give her gum to chew on and stop crying, to silence her hunger.
sentences.zh: 有时连这些都没有，他们就只能给她口香糖嚼，让她停止哭泣，以此来平息她的饥饿。

sentences.en: So I asked her if they had been able to get any aid since the war started.
sentences.zh: 所以我问她，战争开始后他们是否得到过任何援助。

sentences.en: And she told me that her brother, Mohamed, who's 30 years old, had been going to the distribution site and sleeping on the beach, just waiting for aid.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她30岁的哥哥穆罕默德（Mohamed）一直去分发点，睡在海滩上，就为了等援助。

sentences.en: He would leave at 7 in the morning and come back at 3 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他早上7点出门，凌晨3点才回来。

sentences.en: And he slept there for three days last week.
sentences.zh: 上周他在那里睡了三天。

sentences.en: So her brother had been sleeping on the beach in hopes that there would be aid dropped off here.
sentences.zh: 所以她的哥哥一直睡在海滩上，希望能有援助物资投放到那里。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So after waiting for hours near the distribution site on Thursday, he saw the aid trucks coming.
sentences.zh: 周四在分发点附近等了几个小时后，他看到了援助卡车过来。

sentences.en: And along with the crowd, he ran towards them.
sentences.zh: 于是他跟着人群一起跑向卡车。

sentences.en: And suddenly, when the chaos erupted, he just started seeing people dropping to the ground.
sentences.zh: 突然，混乱爆发了，他看到人们开始倒在地上。

sentences.en: And he's actually deaf and mute.
sentences.zh: 他其实是个聋哑人。

sentences.en: So he didn't know what was happening.
sentences.zh: 所以他不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: He just saw people get shot and fall to the ground in front of him.
sentences.zh: 他只看到人们在他面前中枪倒地。

sentences.en: She told me that he saw someone get shot in the head right next to him.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，他亲眼看到旁边有人头部中弹。

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And in the middle of all the chaos and the bloodshed, he was actually able to grab a bag of flour.
sentences.zh: 在混乱和流血之中，他竟然抢到了一袋面粉。

sentences.en: And he just took it and started running really faSt.
sentences.zh: 他拿上袋子就开始飞快地跑。

sentences.en: He was just trying to get away and hold on to that bag of flour that he was able to get.
sentences.zh: 他只是想逃离，并紧紧护住那袋好不容易弄到的面粉。

sentences.en: And while leaving the site, he saw this little kid who was also able to grab a bag of flour.
sentences.zh: 在离开现场时，他看到一个小孩也抢到了一袋面粉。

sentences.en: But she said that he told her that the kid was stopped by local gang members who had attacked him and grabbed the bag of flour from him.
sentences.zh: 但她说，哥哥告诉她，那个孩子被当地的帮派成员拦住了，他们袭击了孩子并抢走了面粉袋。

sentences.en: They stole it from him.
sentences.zh: 他们从孩子手里抢走了它。

sentences.en: And Rada's brother just kept running until he got home, finally.
sentences.zh: 加达的哥哥一直跑，直到最后终于回到了家。

sentences.en: And he came home after three days of sleeping in the sand with a bag of flour.
sentences.zh: 他在沙滩上睡了三天后，带着一袋面粉回到了家。

sentences.en: God, a terrifying night.
sentences.zh: 天哪，真是个可怕的夜晚。

sentences.en: But that was the first time they've had flour in months, since December, basically.
sentences.zh: 但那是他们几个月来，也就是自12月以来，第一次有面粉。

sentences.en: So obviously they wanted to make bread, but that bag was a 25 kilogram bag of flour.
sentences.zh: 显然他们想做面包，但那是一袋25公斤的面粉。

sentences.en: And again, there were 50 people sheltering in one apartment.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍，当时有50个人挤在一间公寓里避难。

sentences.en: So they had to make it last them as long as possible so it could feed all the members of the family.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须让这些面粉尽可能维持更久，这样才能喂饱家里所有的成员。

sentences.en: So actually what they're doing now is they're mixing the flour with animal feed still.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在实际上是在把面粉和动物饲料混合在一起。

sentences.en: They're doing one cup of flour with three cups of animal feed to stretch it out for as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们用一杯面粉混合三杯动物饲料，尽量让它多撑一段时间。

sentences.en: And they're making bread with it.
sentences.zh: 然后用这个做面包。

sentences.en: She said that it was better, but still not normal bread.
sentences.zh: 她说味道好了一些，但仍然不是正常的面包。

sentences.en: It was not what they were craving.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们渴望吃到的东西。

sentences.en: You know, they've been through so much since the war started.
sentences.zh: 你知道，战争开始以来他们经历了太多。

sentences.en: They've seen people killed.
sentences.zh: 他们目睹了人们被杀。

sentences.en: They've seen dead bodies.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了尸体。

sentences.en: They've been displaced 12 times.
sentences.zh: 他们被迫流离失所了12次。

sentences.en: They've lost friends and family members.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了朋友和家人。

sentences.en: But she said that now with the hunger and the starvation in the North, it's really the worst thing they've gone through since the beginning of the war.
sentences.zh: 但她说，现在北部面临的饥饿和饥荒，真的是他们自战争开始以来经历的最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: She said that she's seeing people, kids who are rummaging through trash, trying to find anything to eat.
sentences.zh: 她说她看到人们，看到孩子们在垃圾堆里翻找，试图寻找任何能吃的东西。

sentences.en: And so she said that people were still going back to that same distribution site.
sentences.zh: 所以她说，人们仍然会回到同一个分发点。

sentences.en: She even said that more people were going back on the beach and waiting and camping out and sleeping there, hoping for more aid to come.
sentences.zh: 她甚至说，更多的人回到了海滩上等待、露营、睡在那里，希望能有更多的援助到来。

sentences.en: And she also said that her brother, Mohamed, was also going back every day since Thursday, hoping to get another bag of flour,
sentences.zh: 她还说，她的哥哥穆罕默德自周四以来每天也都回去，希望能再弄到一袋面粉，

sentences.en: because he was so hungry that he wanted to eat anything.
sentences.zh: 因为他太饿了，什么都想吃。

sentences.en: And risking his life for a bag of flour was worth it.
sentences.zh: 为了那一袋面粉冒生命危险是值得的。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that so many people had died on Thursday trying to get flour, where the fact that some people did come home with a bag of flour,
sentences.zh: 尽管周四有那么多人为了抢面粉而丧生，但有些人确实带着面粉回了家，

sentences.en: that was enough for them and others to go back there in hopes that more was going to come.
sentences.zh: 这足以让他们和其他人怀着希望再次回去，期待会有更多的物资到来。

sentences.en: Hiba, thank you.
sentences.zh: 希巴（Hiba），谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜（Sabrina）。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the Biden administration airdropped food into Gaza for the first time.
sentences.zh: 周末，拜登政府首次向加沙空投了食品。

sentences.en: And Vice President Kamala Harris called for a ceasefire, a position she pressed with a member of Israel's war cabinet, Benny Gantz, at the White House on Monday.
sentences.zh: 副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯（Kamala Harris）呼吁停火，她在周一于白宫会见以色列战时内阁成员本尼·甘茨（Benny Gantz）时强调了这一立场。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, 15 trucks were dispatched to northern Gaza on Monday, but at least five were looted along the way.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，周一有15辆卡车被派往加沙北部，但途中至少有5辆遭到洗劫。

sentences.en: And it was unclear how many reached their intended destination.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚有多少卡车到达了预定目的地。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露（Winnalou）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”（promesthesia）的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Supreme Court ruled that states may not bar former President Donald Trump from running for another term,
sentences.zh: 周一，最高法院裁定，各州不得禁止前总统唐纳德·特朗普竞选连任，

sentences.en: rejecting a challenge to Trump's eligibility that had threatened to upend the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 驳回了对特朗普参选资格的挑战，该挑战曾威胁要颠覆总统竞选格局。

sentences.en: The case arose from a challenge brought by Colorado voters who cited Section 3 of the 14th Amendment,
sentences.zh: 此案源于科罗拉多州选民提出的挑战，他们援引了第14修正案第3条，

sentences.en: a provision adopted after the Civil War to forbid those who had taken an oath to support the Constitution from holding office if they engaged in insurrection.
sentences.zh: 这是一项在内战后通过的条款，旨在禁止那些曾宣誓支持宪法的人在参与叛乱后担任公职。

sentences.en: The justices agreed that individual states may not bar candidates from the presidency under that constitutional provision.
sentences.zh: 大法官们一致认为，各州不得根据该宪法条款禁止候选人竞选总统。

sentences.en: It was a unanimous decision that was largely expected.
sentences.zh: 这是一项在很大程度上被预料到的全体一致裁决。

sentences.en: And a United Nations report released on Monday found, quote, reasonable grounds to believe that sexual violence, including rape,
sentences.zh: 此外，联合国周一发布的一份报告发现，有“合理理由相信”在10月7日的袭击中，

sentences.en: was committed in at least three locations in Israel during the October 7th attack.
sentences.zh: 在以色列至少三个地点发生了性暴力，包括强奸。

sentences.en: The Nova Music Festival site, Road 232, and Kibbutz Reim.
sentences.zh: 这三个地点分别是诺瓦音乐节现场、232号公路和雷姆基布兹（Kibbutz Reim）。

sentences.en: The experts also said they had found circumstantial evidence that could indicate sexual violence had occurred
sentences.zh: 专家们还表示，他们发现了间接证据，表明可能发生了性暴力，

sentences.en: with a number of victims, mostly women, who were found fully or partially naked, bound, and shot.
sentences.zh: 受害者多为女性，被发现时全身或部分赤裸、被捆绑并遭到枪杀。

sentences.en: In addition, the UN group said it had found clear and convincing information, based on firsthand accounts from released hostages,
sentences.zh: 此外，联合国小组表示，根据获释人质的第一手陈述，他们发现了清晰且令人信服的信息，

sentences.en: that sexual violence, including rape, was inflicted against some women during their time in captivity in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 证实一些妇女在加沙被俘期间遭受了性暴力，包括强奸。

sentences.en: The report said that the UN team had also heard accounts of sexual violence against Palestinians that implicated Israeli security forces and settlers.
sentences.zh: 报告称，联合国小组还听取了关于巴勒斯坦人遭受性暴力的陈述，这些陈述涉及以色列安全部队和定居者。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Sidney Harper, Rochelle Bonja, and Lindsay Garrison.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由西德尼·哈珀（Sidney Harper）、罗谢尔·邦贾（Rochelle Bonja）和琳赛·加里森（Lindsay Garrison）制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen and Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由利兹·奥巴伦（Liz O'Balen）和丽莎·周（Lisa Chow）编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell, Marianne Lozano, and Alicia Baitu.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）、玛丽安·洛萨诺（Marianne Lozano）和艾丽西亚·拜图（Alicia Baitu）的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利（Alyssa Moxley）进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的Jim Brunberg和Ben Landsberg创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是Sabrina Tavernisi。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客指南。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝到断片才睡着的人。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有过敏症或食物不耐受？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在《纽约时报》应用程序或您常用的播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
